PRACTICE MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE & EMR

Your patients have you, your practice has Jane

Jane brings scheduling, charting, billing, payments, patient communication, and more into one connected system, helping you reduce admin, support your team, and focus on patient care.

Sign up
Explore plans and pricing

Features

The tools your practice needs, connected in one place

See all features

Scheduling

Jane’s appointments & scheduling tools help reduce back-and-forth and minimize no-shows to keep your schedule full and your day organized.

  • Online Booking
  • Customizable Scheduling
  • Automated Email & Text Reminders
  • Virtual Assistants & Receptionists
  • Patient Mobile App

Charting & Care

Confidently keep track of patient care with AI-powered charting, automatic forms, smart templates, performance reports, and more.

  • Documentation
  • AI Scribe
  • Telehealth
  • Intake Forms
  • Secure Messaging
  • Reporting & Analytics

Clinic Management

Streamline your clinic’s finances with features designed to simplify payments, billing, invoicing, and insurance claims.

  • Jane Payments
  • Jane Payroll
  • Billing & Insurance
  • Invoicing & Sales
  • Packages & Memberships

Clinic Marketing

Provide exceptional patient experiences with easy-to-use tools that enable meaningful connection and effective care.

  • Jane Websites
  • Jane SEO
  • Ratings & Reviews

Integrations

Jane works with trusted software tools to make managing all aspects of your practice as seamless as possible.

  • Claim.MD
  • Documo
  • TELUS eClaims
  • Fullscript
  • Wibbi
  • Physitrack
View all integrations

Why jane

Software that understands the work behind the care

Most software manages tasks. Jane helps the whole practice work together.

Reduce your admin load

Jane gives you time back to focus on patients by automating daily tasks like booking, payments, and charting.

Grow with flexible tools

As your practice evolves, so do your tools. Jane has flexible plans and pricing so you can grow confidently.

Provide exceptional care

Make sure every patient touchpoint reflects the quality of care you provide, before, during, and after appointments.

Rely on human support

With Jane, you don’t just get easy-to-use technology. You get an expert team committed to your clinic’s success.
